_what: J15 owners for cat v3: every part of the cat, its OWNING builder, and the check that proves the part is not a Tripo artefact. Written 2026-10-18 by the decisions-owners stage (cat-v3). Sources: V3_BRIEF 'Owners (J15)', PHASE2_ASSESSMENT 1 / 1b, %TEMP%/p2_skin_feat/checks/chk_inventory.json (Phase 2 parts), engine/checks/cat_decisions.py (D1-D7).
rule: An owner may keep a measured (Tripo) surface only after a check shows it is not a Tripo artefact (J15, NOTES_v3). A part whose owner is MISSING inherits Tripo's surface unexamined: v3 must assign the proposed owner before integration.
unseen_side_rule: NOTES_v3 DIRECTION (the person): the UNSEEN side of any part comes from a fitted model of its CLASS (anatomy, a template or a reference library), never from a flat slab or a mirror. Applies to every owner below; flagged where Phase 2 broke it.

status_keys.owner: OWNED = a builder exists and is registered; PARTIAL = a builder exists but does not cover this part yet; MISSING = no builder (Phase 2 inventory: 'no registered builder')
status_keys.check: EXISTS = written and proven on planted failures; PARTIAL = exists but does not test the artefact question; TO_WRITE = named here, not written
status_keys.v2: status on the Phase 2 assembled cat (cat_p2_skin / cat_p2_globes), with its source; checked / estimated / unchecked as labelled
